repos_data.description: Open-source test automation for Android, iOS, web, smart TV (Android TV, Tizen, webOS) and Bluetooth (BLE) devices. Write tests as CSV/YAML, record them live, or let an AI agent build them over MCP. Self-healing locators: XPath, text, OCR, image.
📺 Control any smart TV with natural language. Play Netflix by name from your terminal. PyPI: stv · MCP server · LG/Samsung/Roku/Android
